
  typealias Type_cast_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_type, Vx_Core.Type_any) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_code_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_scope, Int, String, Vx_Core.Type_any) -> String
  typealias Type_copy_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any, Vx_Core.Type_anylist) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_count_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any) -> Int
  typealias Type_func_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_type) -> Vx_Core.Type_func
  typealias Type_get_keyn_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any, String) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_get_indexn_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any, Int) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_listany_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any) -> [Vx_Core.Type_any]
  typealias Type_listkey_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any) -> [String]
  typealias Type_mapany_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any) -> [String:Vx_Core.Type_any]
  typealias Type_new_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_anylist) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_run_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_anylist) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_set_any_anymap_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any, Vx_Core.Type_anymap) -> Vx_Core.Type_any
  typealias Type_set_keyn_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any, String, Vx_Core.Type_any)
  typealias Type_set_indexn_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any, Int, Vx_Core.Type_any)
  typealias Type_shutdown_funcn = (Vx_Core.Type_any)

  // (type generic)
  public class Type_generic {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_cast_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_cast_funcn
    var p_code_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_code_funcn
    var p_copy_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_copy_funcn
    var p_count_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_count_funcn
    var p_func_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_func_funcn
    var p_get_keyn_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_get_keyn_funcn
    var p_get_indexn_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_get_indexn_funcn
    var p_listany_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_listany_funcn
    var p_listkey_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_listkey_funcn
    var p_mapany_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_mapany_funcn
    var p_new_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_new_funcn
    var p_run_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_run_funcn
    var p_set_any_anymap_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_set_any_anymap_funcn
    var p_set_keyn_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_set_keyn_funcn
    var p_set_indexn_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_set_indexn_funcn
    var p_shutdown_funcn : Vx_Core.Type_shutdown_funcn
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_generic
  public static func v_constructor_generic(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_generic {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.Type_generic()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_generic
  public static func v_create_generic(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_generic {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_constructor_generic()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_generic(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_generic
  public static func v_initialize_generic(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_generic
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_generic,
      value)
    value.p_cast_funcn = nil
    value.p_code_funcn = nil
    value.p_copy_funcn = nil
    value.p_count_funcn = nil
    value.p_func_funcn = nil
    value.p_get_keyn_funcn = nil
    value.p_get_indexn_funcn = nil
    value.p_listany_funcn = nil
    value.p_listkey_funcn = nil
    value.p_mapany_funcn = nil
    value.p_new_funcn = nil
    value.p_run_funcn = nil
    value.p_set_any_anymap_funcn = nil
    value.p_set_keyn_funcn = nil
    value.p_set_indexn_funcn = nil
    value.p_shutdown_funcn = nil
  }

  // v_release_generic
  public static func v_release_generic(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_generic
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_generic {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_generic {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_any)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_generic
  public static func v_shutdown_generic(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_generic
  ) {
    value.p_cast_funcn = nil
    value.p_code_funcn = nil
    value.p_copy_funcn = nil
    value.p_count_funcn = nil
    value.p_func_funcn = nil
    value.p_get_keyn_funcn = nil
    value.p_get_indexn_funcn = nil
    value.p_listany_funcn = nil
    value.p_listkey_funcn = nil
    value.p_mapany_funcn = nil
    value.p_new_funcn = nil
    value.p_run_funcn = nil
    value.p_set_any_anymap_funcn = nil
    value.p_set_keyn_funcn = nil
    value.p_set_indexn_funcn = nil
    value.p_shutdown_funcn = nil
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_generic
  public static func v_startup_generic(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_generic
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_generic(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "generic",
      "generic",
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_varmap_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "cast-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_cast_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "code-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_code_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "copy-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_copy_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "count-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_count_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "func-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_func_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "get-keyn-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_get_keyn_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "get-indexn-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_get_indexn_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "listany-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_listany_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "listkey-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_listkeyn_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "mapany-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_mapany_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "new-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_new_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "run-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_run_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "set-any-anymap-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_set_any_anymap_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "set-keyn-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_set_keyn_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "set-indexn-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_set_indexn_funcn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "shutdown-funcn",
          Vx_Core.t_shutdown_funcn)
      ])
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_generic
  public static func v_cast_generic(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_generic {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    if type_any.p_type === Vx_Core.t_generic {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_generic.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_cast_generic
  public static func a_cast_generic(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_generic
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_clone_generic
  public static func v_clone_generic(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_generic
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_generic {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_generic
  public static func v_copy_generic(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_generic,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_generic {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    return output
  }

  // a_copy_generic
  public static func a_copy_generic(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_cast_generic(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_copy_generic(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  public static func v_new_generic(

  }

  public static func a_new_generic(

  // (type lang)
  public class Type_lang {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_name : Vx_Core.Type_string!
    var p_indent : Vx_Core.Type_string!
    var p_pkgref : String
    var p_typeref : String
    var p_isrefcount : Bool
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_lang
  public static func v_constructor_lang(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.Type_lang()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_lang
  public static func v_create_lang(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_constructor_lang()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_lang(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_lang
  public static func v_initialize_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_lang,
      value)
    value.p_name = Vx_Core.e_string
    value.p_indent = Vx_Core.e_string
    value.p_pkgref = ""
    value.p_typeref = ""
    value.p_isrefcount = false
  }

  // v_release_lang
  public static func v_release_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_lang {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_any)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.e_lang
    return output
  }

  // v_reserve_lang
  public static func v_reserve_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_any(
      value.p_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = value
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_lang
  public static func v_shutdown_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang
  ) {
    value.p_name = Vx_Core.v_release_string(
      value.p_name)
    value.p_indent = Vx_Core.v_release_string(
      value.p_indent)
    value.p_pkgref = ""
    value.p_typeref = ""
    value.p_isrefcount = false
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_lang
  public static func v_startup_lang(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_lang
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.e_lang
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_lang(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "lang",
      "lang",
      Vx_Core.c_extends_struct,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_varmap_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "name",
          Vx_Core.t_string),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "indent",
          Vx_Core.t_string),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "pkgref",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "typeref",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "isrefcount",
          Vx_Core.t_booleann)
      ])
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.a_copy_lang
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.a_new_lang
    type_generic.p_get_keyn_funcn = Vx_Core.a_get_keyn_lang
    type_generic.p_mapany_funcn = Vx_Core.a_mapany_lang
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_lang
  public static func v_cast_lang(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.e_lang
    if type_any.p_type === Vx_Core.t_lang {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_lang.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_cast_lang
  public static func a_cast_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_clone_lang
  public static func v_clone_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_create_lang()
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_lang
  public static func v_copy_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.e_lang
    return output
  }

  // a_copy_lang
  public static func a_copy_lang(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_cast_lang(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_copy_lang(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_new_lang
  public static func v_new_lang(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_copy_lang(
      Vx_Core.e_lang,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // a_new_lang
  public static func a_new_lang(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_new_lang(
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_get_keyn_lang
  public static func v_get_keyn_lang(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_lang,
    _ keyn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.e_any
    switch keyn {
    case "name":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_string(
        value.p_name)
    case "indent":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_string(
        value.p_indent)
    case "pkgref":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_string(
        Vx_Core.v_string_cast_stringn(
          value.p_pkgref))
    case "typeref":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_string(
        Vx_Core.v_string_cast_stringn(
          value.p_typeref))
    case "isrefcount":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_boolean(
        Vx_Core.v_boolean_cast_booleann(
          value.p_isrefcount))
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_get_keyn_lang
  public static func a_get_keyn_lang(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ keyn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_cast_lang(
      type_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_get_keyn_lang(
      value,
      keyn)
    return output
  }

  // a_mapany_lang
  public static func a_mapany_lang(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> [String:Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    var output : [String:Vx_Core.Type_any] = [:]
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_cast_lang(
      type_any)
    let listkey : [String] = Vx_Core.v_listkey_any(
      type_any)
    for keyn in listkey {
      let sub_any : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_get_keyn_lang(
        value,
        keyn)
      if sub_any !== Vx_Core.e_any {
        output[keyn] = sub_any
      }
    }
    return output
  }

  // f_lang
  public static func f_lang(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_lang {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_lang = Vx_Core.v_new_lang(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

          "lang",
          Vx_Core.t_lang),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "package",
          Vx_Core.t_package),

    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()

    type_generic.p_get_keyn_funcn = Vx_Core.a_get_keyn_scope

    return output
  }

  // v_cast_scope
  public static func v_cast_scope(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_scope {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.e_scope
    if type_any.p_type === Vx_Core.t_scope {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_scope.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_cast_scope
  public static func a_cast_scope(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_scope
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_clone_scope
  public static func v_clone_scope(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_scope
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_scope {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_create_scope()
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_scope
  public static func v_copy_scope(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_scope,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_scope {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.e_scope
    return output
  }

  // a_copy_scope
  public static func a_copy_scope(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_cast_scope(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_copy_scope(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_new_scope
  public static func v_new_scope(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_scope {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_copy_scope(
      Vx_Core.e_scope,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // a_new_scope
  public static func a_new_scope(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_new_scope(
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_get_keyn_scope
  public static func v_get_keyn_scope(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_scope,
    _ keyn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.e_any
    switch keyn {
    case "lang":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_lang(
        value.p_lang)
    case "package":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_package(
        value.p_package)
    case "project":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_project(
        value.p_project)
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_get_keyn_scope
  public static func a_get_keyn_scope(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ keyn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_cast_scope(
      type_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_get_keyn_scope(
      value,
      keyn)
    return output
  }

  // a_mapany_scope
  public static func a_mapany_scope(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> [String:Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    var output : [String:Vx_Core.Type_any] = [:]
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_cast_scope(
      type_any)
    let listkey : [String] = Vx_Core.v_listkey_any(
      type_any)
    for keyn in listkey {
      let sub_any : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_get_keyn_scope(
        value,
        keyn)
      if sub_any !== Vx_Core.e_any {
        output[keyn] = sub_any
      }
    }
    return output
  }

  // f_scope
  public static func f_scope(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_scope {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_scope = Vx_Core.v_new_scope(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // (type var)
  public class Type_var {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_pkgname : Vx_Core.Type_string!
    var p_name : Vx_Core.Type_string!
    var p_type : Vx_Core.Type_type!
    var p_value : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_mutable : Vx_Core.Type_boolean!
    var p_nullable : Vx_Core.Type_boolean!
    var p_private : Vx_Core.Type_boolean!
    var p_public : Vx_Core.Type_boolean!
    var p_static : Vx_Core.Type_boolean!
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_var
  public static func v_constructor_var(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_var {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_var = Vx_Core.Type_var()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_var
  public static func v_create_var(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_var {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_var = Vx_Core.v_constructor_var()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_var(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_var
  public static func v_initialize_var(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_var
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_var,
      value)
    value.p_pkgname = Vx_Core.e_string
    value.p_name = Vx_Core.e_string
    value.p_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    value.p_value = Vx_Core.e_any
    value.p_mutable = Vx_Core.c_false
    value.p_nullable = Vx_Core.c_false
    value.p_private = Vx_Core.c_false
    value.p_public = Vx_Core.c_false
    value.p_static = Vx_Core.c_false
  }

  // v_release_var
  public static func v_release_var(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_var
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_var {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_var {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_any)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_var = Vx_Core.e_var
    return output
  }

  // v_reserve_var
  public static func v_reserve_var(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_var
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_var {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_any(
      value.p_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_var = value
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_var
  public static func v_shutdown_var(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_var
  ) {
    value.p_pkgname = Vx_Core.v_release_string(
      value.p_pkgname)
    value.p_name = Vx_Core.v_release_string(
      value.p_name)
    value.p_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    value.p_value = Vx_Core.v_release_any(
      value.p_value)
    value.p_mutable = Vx_Core.v_release_boolean(
      value.p_mutable)
    value.p_nullable = Vx_Core.v_release_boolean(
      value.p_nullable)
    value.p_private = Vx_Core.v_release_boolean(
      value.p_private)
    value.p_public = Vx_Core.v_release_boolean(
      value.p_public)
    value.p_static = Vx_Core.v_release_boolean(
      value.p_static)
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_var
  public static func v_startup_var(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_var
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_var = Vx_Core.e_var
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_var(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "var",
      "var",
      Vx_Core.c_extends_struct,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_varmap_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "pkgname",
          Vx_Core.t_string),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "name",
          Vx_Core.t_string),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "type",
          Vx_Core.t_type),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "value",
          Vx_Core.t_any),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "mutable",
          Vx_Core.t_boolean),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "nullable",
          Vx_Core.t_boolean),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "private",
          Vx_Core.t_boolean),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "public",
          Vx_Core.t_boolean),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "static",
          Vx_Core.t_boolean)
      ])
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.a_copy_var
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.a_new_var
    type_generic.p_get_keyn_funcn = Vx_Core.a_get_keyn_var
    type_generic.p_mapany_funcn = Vx_Core.a_mapany_var
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_var

    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any

        value.p_mutable)
    case "nullable":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_boolean(
        value.p_nullable)
    case "private":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_boolean(
        value.p_private)
    case "public":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_boolean(
        value.p_public)
    case "static":
      output = Vx_Core.a_cast_boolean(
        value.p_static)
    }
    return output
  }

  // (type varlist)
  public class Type_varlist {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_listvar : [Vx_Core.Type_var]!
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_varlist
  public static func v_constructor_varlist(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_varlist {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.Type_varlist()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_varlist
  public static func v_create_varlist(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_varlist {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.v_constructor_varlist()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_varlist(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_varlist
  public static func v_initialize_varlist(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_varlist,
      value)
    value.p_listvar = []
  }

  // v_release_varlist
  public static func v_release_varlist(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_varlist {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_varlist {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_any)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.e_varlist
    return output
  }

  // v_reserve_varlist
  public static func v_reserve_varlist(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_varlist {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_any(
      value.p_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = value
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_varlist
  public static func v_shutdown_varlist(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist
  ) {
    let listany : [Vx_Core.Type_any] = Vx_Core.v_listany_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_listany(
      listany)
    value.p_listvar = nil
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_varlist
  public static func v_startup_varlist(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_varlist
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.e_varlist
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_varlist(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "varlist",
      "varlist",
      Vx_Core.c_extends_list,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_container = Vx_Core.t_var
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.a_copy_varlist
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.a_new_varlist
    type_generic.p_get_indexn_funcn = Vx_Core.a_get_indexn_varlist
    type_generic.p_listany_funcn = Vx_Core.a_listany_varlist
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {

      type_anylist)

    return output
  }

  // v_get_indexn_varlist
  public static func v_get_indexn_varlist(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist,
    _ indexn : Int
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_var {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_var = Vx_Core.e_var
    let listitem : [Vx_Core.Type_var] = value.p_listvar
    if listitem.count <= indexn {
      let offsetn : Int = indexn -
        1
      let item : Vx_Core.Type_var = listitem[offsetn]
      output = item
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_get_indexn_varlist
  public static func a_get_indexn_varlist(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ indexn : Int
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.v_cast_varlist(
      type_any)
    let item : Vx_Core.Type_var = Vx_Core.v_get_indexn_varlist(
      value,
      indexn)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = item.p_any
    return output
  }

  // a_listany_varlist
  public static func a_listany_varlist(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> [Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.v_cast_varlist(
      type_any)
    let listvar : [Vx_Core.Type_var] = value.p_listvar
    let output : [Vx_Core.Type_any] = Vx_Core.v_listany_from_listvar_varlist(
      listvar)
    return output
  }

  // v_listany_from_listvar_varlist
  public static func v_listany_from_listvar_varlist(
    _ listvar : [Vx_Core.Type_var]
  ) -> [Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    var output : [Vx_Core.Type_any] = []
    for value in listvar {
      output.append(value.p_any)
    }
    return output
  }

  // f_varlist
  public static func f_varlist(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_varlist {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_varlist = Vx_Core.v_new_varlist(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // v_release_boolean
  public static func v_release_boolean(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_boolean
